name: Real-Time Dashboard
description: A dashboard is a collection of tiles, optionally organized in pages, where each tile has an underlying query and a visual representation. Natively export Kusto Query Language (KQL) queries to a dashboard as visuals and later modify their underlying queries and visual formatting as needed. In addition to ease of data exploration, this fully integrated dashboard experience provides improved query and visualization performance with light, flexible modeling on high granularity low latency data.
